_doc: Odd jobs (src/sim/game/jobs.ts, docs/story.md Odd jobs): two gig boards, each in a city room (at: room/anchor; host: who runs it; hello: their line when you read it, empty: when every gig today is done), with perDay gigs a day of its kinds (gigs), the same for everyone on a San Francisco date: a hash of board, date and slot picks the kind's client, their line and the target. deliver: the order from the board's spot to the client (items; seconds: base + metres in a straight line / speed, rounded up to 5); carry: the client picked up at the kerb by their home in the board's van, to a spot from to (minFrom..maxFrom metres from them; radius); photo: a trick from tricks near a spot from spots (radius); race: beat the client along a course (distance: how close to set them off; finish: metres from the end). Every client line is voiced (tools/gen_voices.py). after: missions done or skipped before the boards open (the client's save). decks: a deck for the board shop after so many gigs from a board (the client's save; stickers.json has the gig stickers).

hello.text: Gig board. Small jobs. In ninety-four I took a small job. Eleven stitches.

empty.text: That's every gig today. Go home. Ice something.

hello.text: Orders on the board. Every order is a promise. Carry it with both hands.

empty.text: No more orders today. Tomorrow, new promises.

say.text: Bring it to Clarion Alley. I'm filming it arriving. That's the whole film.

done.text: Got it. The phone was closed. Bring another one tomorrow.

late.text: The light's gone. The film is about waiting now.

say.text: For the band. Not the trumpet. He knows what he did.

done.text: Gracias. Look, the trumpet is here. He smelled it.

late.text: It's cold. Now it's a sad song.

say.text: It's for you. Bring it here and eat it in front of me.

done.text: Sit. Eat. All of it. I'm counting.

late.text: Late. Look at you. Thinner already.

say.text: To the J Church stop, please. I'll be here. The train won't.

done.text: Thank you. Still no train. Great timing, though.

late.text: You took so long I nearly caught a train.

say.text: I ordered food. I cannot eat. I would like to hold it.

done.text: It is warm. I understand everything now.

late.text: It is cold. I understand nothing again.

say.text: Leave it on the ground. That's where I eat.

done.text: Nice. The guac stays between us.

late.text: Too slow. The seagulls are asking questions.

say.text: Leave it on the step. Don't knock. Don't breathe.

done.text: Thank you. Now back away. The porch creaks.

late.text: Too late. They're awake. Both of them.

say.text: Lunch, for an experiment. The experiment is lunch.

done.text: Mass delivered. Science thanks you.

late.text: Slower than a falling apple. I timed it.

say.text: My bike's got a flat. I need a ride. I'll be judging your braking.

ride.text: You stopped at a stop sign. Interesting choice.

done.text: Thanks. You braked forty times. I counted.

say.text: Drive me, please. Arriving by van is a statement.

ride.text: This pothole says a great deal about the city.

done.text: Thank you. I'll write about this ride. Unfavourably.

say.text: My cart broke and the sun is winning. Drive me and the paletas.

ride.text: Mango is sweating. Coconut is holding on.

done.text: Made it. We lost the mango. It died doing what it loved.

say.text: My car's in the shop. Pick me up. Drive low and slow.

ride.text: You call this low? My car is lower parked.

done.text: Thanks, mijo. If anyone asks, I walked.

say.text: Mayor Biscuits has a meeting. I need a ride. I am his assistant.

ride.text: He's asleep. Take the bumps gently. He's the Mayor.

done.text: The Mayor thanks you. He's still asleep, but he thanks you.

say.text: One shot for the edit. Do it like you mean it. Then do it again.

done.text: Got it. It's fine. It's the best fine I've had all week.

say.text: Candid shot, please. I'll tell you when to be candid.

done.text: Perfect. I'm captioning it 'spontaneous'.

say.text: Shot for my film. The phone's open. That's half the battery.

done.text: Got it. Eleven pixels. Every one of them is you.

say.text: I need evidence. A photo of you defying me.

done.text: Inconclusive. I'm framing it anyway.

courses.text: down Guerrero, along the Dolores wall

say.text: Race you. Loser says the other one's stance is fine.

done.text: Fine. Your stance is fine. I hate this.

won.text: Your stance is still not fine.

say.text: Race. Try not to be mid about it.

done.text: Less mid than usual.

say.text: Race you. If I win, I get your board. I need one.

done.text: Fine. I'll find my own board. One of them's somewhere.

won.text: I won. Can I have your board? Mine's gone again.

say.text: A race, darling? I've been rolling since Carter. Keep up.

done.text: You beat me. Don't tell the Castro.

won.text: Since the Carter administration, darling. Still rolling.

say.text: Race you. I usually do this street at three miles an hour. In a truck.

done.text: You won. I'm going back to the truck. The truck respects me.
